cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These minutes say 'a proposal was discussed'. Mine. Minutes need names and decisions, please. What happened to both?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Nobody' isn't a list of attendees. Who asked you to remove my name? Please answer that before reaching for the pen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present it so the proposal had a chance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Name the presenter, please. And what is the objection to me presenting it? 'Had a chance' is another outcome without a reason.

reason: Clarify the exact anonymous minutes wording and let A's record-keeping corrections extract the concealed presenter and reason.
